We are continuing to improve Quest Hunter. This update will give fixes for localisation. And we have fixed some game bugs. For example, the 10th wave in "Clash on Graveyard" comes back.

Cheers!

notes.title: Version 1.0.12
notes.notes:
Greetings Hunters!

We have done great optimisation work because we had not the best performance on Switch. And now we have uploaded this new version to Steam. So, if you have not the best device to play, this update will give you better performance.

Also, we have added some not major features like Steam Rich Presence for a better experience with friends.
Had fixed many bugs. Tuned some quests logic.
Now you can change difficulty at any time from easy to hard and back.

Done Japanese localisation.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28269558/d21f6e8dcb180e2dfa6429c750721952ac2341e5.png

And yes, we are working on the new content for the game. And with other localisations.

Cheers!

notes.title: Update every month!
notes.notes:
http://i.imgur.com/Kisa9Uq.gif
Hello adventurers!
We are glad to say that Quest Hunter is live! Now you can buy it with a 15% discount!

And we want to announce our plans for the future. Every month we want to give you a free update to our main story with some new content.
Also we are reading your feedback. It helps a lot! Thank you! We use your feedback to improve the game and work on bugs and balance fixes.

P. S. If you still haven’t watched it - 4 players cooperative gameplay video: 
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1097256730
